findings.rootCause: Filesystem-writing functions joined model-controlled IDs/paths directly with baseDir without canonical workspace boundary validation, path traversal checks, symlink/reparse checks, or atomic rollback on downstream error.
findings.negativeTest: Rejects traversal IDs (../../../neighbor-project/pwned), Windows reserved names (CON), unauthorized workspace roots, and rolls back multi-file transactions atomically on failure.

findings.rootCause: User-controlled runId and browserVersion were interpolated directly into double-quoted PowerShell strings in generated RUN.ps1.
findings.regressionTest: tests/phase-3-audit-reproductions.test.ts :: 3. P0 — Safe Generated Code & Operator Bundles (Findings #2 & #3)
findings.negativeTest: Rejects runId with $(...) PowerShell subexpression and verifies static RUN.ps1 reads expected-evidence.json as structured data without executing injected expressions.

findings.rootCause: Renderers interpolated blueprint titles, descriptions, and attributes without context-sensitive HTML/JSX/Blade/Razor escaping, and handleRenderBlueprint performed post-render raw string replacement.
findings.regressionTest: tests/phase-3-audit-reproductions.test.ts :: 3. P0 — Safe Generated Code & Operator Bundles (Findings #2 & #3)
findings.negativeTest: Verifies </title><script>window.__XSS=1</script> in blueprint title and description is HTML/JSX/Blade/Razor escaped and never executes in DOM.

findings.rootCause: Model-controlled arguments (approvedBy, confirmedByUser, reviewedBy, explicitUserApproval) were trusted directly to mint USER_DECISION and VERIFIED status without cryptographic host authorization binding.
findings.negativeTest: Rejects self-approved model claims (approvedBy:'user', confirmedByUser:true), tampered tokens, mismatched scope/hash, replayed nonces, and expired tokens with HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.

findings.rootCause: Substring regex matching matched width inside max-width producing max-max-width, applied CSS patches to non-CSS files (e.g. JS string literals), and hardcoded functionalPreservationCheck flags to true.
findings.negativeTest: Verifies identical CSS text inside HTML and JS files is never modified, max-width never becomes max-max-width, repairs are idempotent, and unverified repairs report verificationSkipped:true.

findings.rootCause: Weighted score formula treated missing API calls as non-blocking warnings, ignored formIdentifiers and databaseInvariants in preservation verdict, and returned preserved:true on empty baselines.
findings.negativeTest: Returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (preserved:false) on empty baselines and REGRESSION_DETECTED (preserved:false) when any API route, form, auth guard, or DB invariant is removed without host approval token.

findings.rootCause: compressBuildLog only matched 4 specific error regexes and defaulted to [BUILD_OK] TypeScript compiled cleanly with 0 errors when no line matched, without checking exit code or fatal linker/compiler patterns.
findings.negativeTest: Retains FATAL: ld returned 1 exit status with status FAILED, and refuses to emit [BUILD_OK] when exitCode is missing/non-zero or log is truncated.

findings.rootCause: Claims not matching the 7 hardcoded regex patterns returned VERIFIED whenever any evidence array item was passed, even if verified:false, failed, stale, or unrelated.
findings.negativeTest: Rejects claims backed by verified:false, failed, synthetic, stale, or domain-unrelated evidence with NOT_VERIFIED.

findings.rootCause: Non-existent or empty directory returned 0 files which downstream auditors scored as 100 UI health and 1.0 a11y pass ratio; collectProjectFiles also read .env* files.
findings.negativeTest: Returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and 0 health score on non-existent/empty directories and excludes .env*, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa files from scanning.

findings.rootCause: loadCatalog checked process.cwd() before the trusted package installation root without explicit override opt-in or provenance tagging.
findings.regressionTest: tests/phase-3-audit-reproductions.test.ts :: 9. P1 — Trusted Source & Catalog Loading (Finding #10)
findings.negativeTest: Ignores untrusted workspace catalog files in process.cwd() by default and strips prompt-injection strings from catalog descriptions.

findings.rootCause: Server only handled legacy MCP initialize handshake and returned -32601 Method not found for modern server/discover requests.
findings.negativeTest: Verifies both legacy initialize (2024-11-05), modern initialize (2025-03-26), and server/discover over stdio JSON-RPC.

findings.rootCause: JSON Schema definitions and Zod runtime parsers were maintained separately by hand, causing 18 tool contract mismatches.
findings.negativeTest: Differential test across all 124 canonical tools verifies 0 schema-minimal parser mismatches and rejects invalid payload types.

findings.rootCause: RouteContextInputSchema defaulted missing mode to REPAIR; mode detection regex missed 'modernize'; read-only tasks recommended editing tools; skill scoring missed 41/55 positive cases and selected 5/55 negative exclusion cases.
findings.regressionTest: tests/phase-3-audit-reproductions.test.ts :: 8. P1 — Agent Skills Discovery & Routing (Finding #13)
findings.negativeTest: Achieves 55/55 positive hits, 0/55 exclusion false positives, 100% precision on 20-item bilingual EN/TR held-out corpus, and never recommends mutating tools on read-only tasks.

findings.rootCause: Keyword 'inspect' was checked before requireLiveBrowser and browser/console context, routing 'inspect browser console' to view_file.

findings.rootCause: Parity evaluator assigned hardcoded scores (96.5, 95.0, 98.0) and PASS status without inspecting rendered DOM, interactive controls, or accessibility attributes across the 4 stacks.
findings.negativeTest: Computes structural/semantic/a11y parity from actual rendered outputs across all 4 stacks and marks verificationStatus UNVERIFIED when live browser style/interaction evidence is absent.

findings.rootCause: Screenshot failure was not included in passed boolean; pageerror events were not captured; overflow check only inspected documentElement/body and missed inner element clipping/overflow.
findings.negativeTest: Fails inspection when uncaught pageerror occurs, when inner container overflows horizontally, or when screenshot capture fails/produces 0 bytes.

findings.rootCause: SSR theme script set data-theme='light' or 'dark' once on load without tracking SYSTEM mode or registering a matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') change listener; HTML renderer omitted theme runtime synchronization.
findings.negativeTest: Verifies SSR theme script tracks data-theme-mode='system' and registers a live matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') change event listener.

findings.rootCause: Regex and substring basename matching were labeled as deterministic AST extraction (EXTRACTED), matching commented-out exports, failing on duplicate basenames, and omitting coverage/heuristic provenance.
findings.negativeTest: Strips comments and string literals before import/export extraction, labels basename test edges as HEURISTIC (0.65), and reports unsupportedFiles coverage metrics.

findings.rootCause: Destructive command guard ignored raw non-JSON stdin and PowerShell destructive cmdlets; default test suite ran network package installs and disabled composer security advisory blocking; missing licenses fell back to MIT.
